notes: One-click updates: kill-first helper, no waiting, no manual steps
patch_notes: The update flow is now truly one-click, at Ariya's request. The helper no longer waits politely for the app to close: its first move is to force-close every running copy of GameModeVPN.exe, then verify they are gone (a short capped check), rebuild and reopen. The app itself exits within a second of the click. Test rounds 14, 16 and 20 updated for the kill-first helper; all 23 rounds pass.
